title: First steps in Lean
Lean 的第一步
summary: Five one-line proofs: read the goal, pick one tactic, watch it turn green.
五個一行的證明：讀懂目標、挑一個戰術，看著它變綠。

title: From points to matrices
從點到矩陣
summary: Geometry with whole-number coordinates, then the vectors and 2 × 2 matrices behind it.
用整數座標做幾何，接著是背後的向量與 2 × 2 矩陣。

title: When omega gives up
當 omega 放棄時
summary: omega solves linear arithmetic, but not products of unknowns. Each problem here needs another move: compute, rewrite, a calc chain, or grind.
omega 能解線性算術，卻不能處理未知數相乘。這裡每一題都需要別的招式：計算、改寫、calc 推導鏈，或 grind。

title: Building a proof step by step
一步一步搭起證明
summary: Proofs in several moves: each step leaves a smaller goal, until nothing is left.
分好幾步完成的證明：每一步都留下更小的目標，直到什麼都不剩。

title: Pythagoras, three ways
畢氏定理的三種寫法
summary: One example by computation, the algebra for perpendicular vectors, then the theorem itself in Mathlib's Euclidean geometry.
先用計算看一個例子，再證垂直向量的代數，最後是 Mathlib 歐氏幾何中的定理本身。

title: IMO problems, proved in Lean
用 Lean 證明的 IMO 題目
summary: Olympiad problems with complete Lean proofs from compfiles (Apache-2.0), from 1959 to 2005. They need Mathlib: read the proofs on the Lite runner, run them on a Full runner.
1959 到 2005 年的奧林匹亞題目，附 compfiles（Apache-2.0）的完整 Lean 證明。它們需要 Mathlib：在 Lite 執行器上閱讀證明，在 Full 執行器上執行。

title: When Lean says no
當 Lean 說不
summary: A wrong statement, a false conjecture and a proof with a gap: three different ways for mathematics on paper to go wrong, each caught by a check Lean can run.
一個寫錯的陳述、一個錯的猜想、一個有漏洞的證明：紙上數學出錯的三種不同方式，每一種都被 Lean 能做的檢查抓到。
